m-pv4ger.summary: Native 320px was too slow (~130 s/epoch), so I downsized to 128px. cnn_small reached 0.929. resnet_small at lr 3e-3 was unstable (0.904, early stopped), but at lr 1e-3 it reached 0.941, the best run. Resolution 160 (0.915, fewer epochs, early stopped) and higher weight decay with a new seed (0.936) did not beat it. I selected exp-20261031T181019Z-94b654. Differences of about 0.5 points are near seed noise.

m-pv4ger-seg.summary: The only prior run was a one-epoch smoke test (mIoU 0.41). With one experiment left, I trained unet_small at input size 160, lr 0.003, batch size 16 for 14 epochs. Downscaling made epochs about 9 s instead of about 64 s at native size. It reached val mIoU 0.923 (foreground IoU 0.878, pixel accuracy 0.974), and the curve was still rising at the last epoch. I selected it. The experiment budget is now exhausted, so I tried no unet_medium run, no higher resolution and no longer schedule.
